CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vibebloom_vpn_nodes (
  region_code VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY,
  region_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  aws_region VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  instance_type VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 't3.micro (Free Tier)',
  ebs_gb INTEGER DEFAULT 10,
  status VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT 'STOPPED',
  public_ip VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT 'Auto-Assigned on Boot',
  wg_port INTEGER DEFAULT 51820,
  scraper_port INTEGER DEFAULT 8085,
  hours_used_month NUMERIC(6,2) DEFAULT 0.0,
  last_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  auto_stop_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  browser_profile VARCHAR(64),
  target_timezone VARCHAR(64),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(v ORDER BY CASE v.region_code WHEN 'US' THEN 1 WHEN 'UK' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END), '[]'::json) FROM vibebloom_vpn_nodes v) AS vpn_nodes,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM vibebloom_scraped_trends ORDER BY scraped_at DESC, demand_score DESC LIMIT 24) t) AS trends,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(m ORDER BY m.region_code), '[]'::json) FROM vibebloom_mobile_telemetry m) AS telemetry;

const dbRow = $input.first()?.json || {}; const vpnNodes = Array.isArray(dbRow.vpn_nodes) ? dbRow.vpn_nodes : []; const trends = Array.isArray(dbRow.trends) ? dbRow.trends : []; const telemetry = Array.isArray(dbRow.telemetry) ? dbRow.telemetry : []; const initialDataJson = JSON.stringify({ vpnNodes, trends, telemetry }); const html = ` LouLou & Luxe — Multi-Region VPN, Etsy/Amazon Trend Scraper & Mobile Ad Monitor
L&L

Mumbai KVM2 Brain + Live AWS US/UK/AU Exit Nodes

Pulls real-time buyer autocomplete & bestseller signals from US (USD), UK (GBP), and Australia (AUD), then runs Gemini 2.5 Flash + Local Ollama (llama3.2:3b) to create copyright-safe slogans & UTM links.

AWS Free Plan Guardrail ($0.01 Budget Alert + 30GB EBS Total Across All Websites)

Live AWS Multi-Region VPN & Scraper Exit Nodes (US, UK, AUS)

Connected to Account 631139986237 (us-east-1, eu-west-2, ap-southeast-2). EventBridge automatically stops any node after 3 hours.

Combined Free-Tier Hours Used
0.7 / 750.0 hrs

🚀 Deployed CloudFormation Stack Details (Account 631139986237)

US (i-0c4303321e038ce25), UK (i-0b433e06757039943), and AU (i-0a9bacc318aa21436) are provisioned via CloudFormation with WireGuard (wg0 UDP 51820 + wg-easy TCP 51821) and Regional Scraper API (TCP 8085).

Safe for Indian Smartphone (No TikTok App / Zero Indian SIM Leak)

📱 Real-Time Mobile Content, Ad ROAS & LouLou & Luxe Order Monitor

Bookmark this URL on the operator's phone in India. It pulls live metrics via Mumbai n8n so nobody ever logs into the TikTok mobile app with an Indian SIM card.

Step-by-Step Organic TikTok Account Creation

Where & How to Create the Organic @LouLouLuxe.US Account

⚠️ CRITICAL: Do NOT click the TikTok signup link in your regular Indian browser! Indian ISPs block it, and if you sign up on an Indian IP, TikTok permanently tags the account as Region: IN (banned).

  1. Open your isolated US Browser Profile (Camoufox or Dolphin{anty}) with your US IP / VPN active.
  2. First, verify your browser shows 100% United States (IP + Timezone) at: https://whoer.net
  3. Inside that US browser, open the official TikTok Email Signup URL:
    https://www.tiktok.com/signup/phone-or-email/email
  4. Sign up using Email (e.g., user@example.com or user@example.com) — do NOT enter an Indian +91 phone number!
  5. Once logged in, go to Settings → Switch to Business Account → Apparel & Accessories.
  6. 3-Day Warm-Up (While Payoneer Verifies): Spend 10–15 mins/day scrolling & liking US floral/fashion TikToks before uploading your first video so TikTok scores the account as a genuine US human creator.
Multi-Website Scaling Across US, UK & AUS

Launching Website #2, #3, #N for the Same 3 Regions

  • AWS VPN & Scraper Nodes ($0 Extra): Never spin up additional EC2 instances for new websites (that would exceed the 30 GB Free-Tier EBS cap). Reuse the exact same 3 US/UK/AUS nodes across all websites.
  • Mumbai KVM2 n8n + PostgreSQL ($0 Extra): Add a new folder under Personal > POD > [New Website] and pass brand_slug to the shared scraper pipeline.
  • Camoufox Browser Profiles (Free): Create 3 fresh isolated browser profiles per new website (Brand2 - USA, Brand2 - UK, Brand2 - AUS) so TikTok never links cookies across brands.
  • Static Residential Proxy (~$3/mo): 1 Static US Residential ISP IP safely supports up to 2 TikTok brand accounts per region. Add a 2nd proxy only when launching Brand #3.
LouLou & Luxe (LouLou&Luxe) Multi-Region VPN, Etsy/Amazon Trend Scraper & AI Pipeline • Hosted on Mumbai KVM2 (automations.sbanerjee.cloud → Personal > POD > LouLou & Luxe)
`; return [{ json: { html } }];
